axes.A: 13 actual drawNumber identities:0/123right,blue/cyan base,left/mid,truncation,missingframe,transparenthole vs opaque0,lastrow,missingones retainingtens spacing,positive/zero value with nLength0. Real renderer/blitter/framebuffer read. nLength0 is valid nonnegative public-helper input and C branch behavior, ordinary menu caller uses2/4/5 slots; no claim ordinary0slot reachability.
axes.B: Removed old author/wave absolute nonduplication header. Kept explicit digit dimensions, fixed coordinates, opaque0 and truncation explanations. No assertion that snapshot or callcount proves pixel output; no new misleading annotation found within candidate.
axes.C: Layout/color/slot/mask raster contracts live in number main; fresh framebuffer and owned digit arrays percase, shared factory returns independent buffers. No gameglobal, IO/async cancellation/clock lifecycle needed. Base map and seam heuristics stay separate.
axes.D: Reuse same canonical createDigitFrames at exact version; private digitFramesWithMask replaces one slot with explicit mask/indices. expectDigitPixels fills expected literal rectangles without recomputing SUT alignment/digits. No universal image host or extra shared export.
axes.E: All13callbacks/assertions typed-alpha-conserved. Full-frame Buffer expected checksmask/row/spacing and drawbounds; existing color/mid/truncate oracles stay literal. Real7files58/58,gameTC0,0pending/stderr. No new count/coverage-only cases or testretirement.
axes.F: draw-number.test now owns formerly author-based mask/slot cases. digitFramesWithMask and expectDigitPixels describe array return and raster assertion; stable G05 IDs only caseprovenance. Source/public parameter names unchanged.
axes.G: Remove separate author-spec wrapper/imports while retain distinct0slot branches, transparency and lastrow. Two actual mask factory callers justify local helper; no dead export/parameter or speculative flag introduced.
